title: Bi2Te3 Deep Potential Workflow Package for Ultra-Flexibility Merges High Power Density in Single-Crystal Bi2Te3 Film Thermoelectric Generators
description: Computational workflow, model metadata, representative inputs, and atomistic simulation outputs for the Bi2Te3 DeepMD/DPGEN/LAMMPS/VASP calculations used in the associated Nature Communications manuscript.
